name: seamtrail
description: SeamTrail, your team's shared memory, in Gemini CLI: each chat asks once which SeamTrail project it is for, then gets that project's context and, at every message, what is new on its work — from ticket numbers and the agent's short summary, never the conversation — and is reminded at turn end to save what was decided.

seamtrail.description: SeamTrail: your team's shared memory of its projects.

settings.name: SeamTrail token
settings.description: Make one in SeamTrail: Settings → Agents · MCP connector → Token → Make a token (name it "Gemini CLI"). It works as you; revoke it there any time.
